title: EIP-712 compliance Issue in `Marketplace`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `TRADE_TYPEHASH` in the Marketplace contract is computed using a struct that references `TradeGive` and `TradeTake`.
